sections.title: Market review
sections.body: No scorecard printed today — there were no prior checks to settle and no open commitments carried into the session. The ledger is empty; nothing settled and nothing opened. The record starts here.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.body: The day resolved as relief rather than a directional break. Volatility strengthened its downtrend — VIXCLS was the widest mover against its own median, and a sub-15 print corroborates the jobs-as-all-clear read; watch whether it holds under 15 next week. Rates continued to do nothing, the long end easing only marginally, so duration is not yet expressing the live-hike risk the front end prices — watch DGS10 against 4.85. Credit continued its calm, spreads tight enough to say the loud move underneath is supply-driven, not solvency. The El Nino ag theme strengthened hard, topping the rotation table on both one- and multi-week excess; its kill switch is not armed, so it continues until ONI or relative performance turns. Semis rotated violently under a flat index — Memory and Foundry up, Cyber and Software down — a single-week churn worth watching for follow-through into next week rather than a settled trend.

oneThing.title: The one thing
oneThing.body: Yesterday: no prior checks. The frame found no single dominant move today, so it ran on persistence, and the widest mover against its own median was volatility: VIXCLS at 14.32 versus 15.2 prior, a -0.88 pts move. That is the story of the session — cooling August wages capped the inflation scare while firm hiring kept a September hike live, so vol drained instead of spiking rather than a directional break.
